title: Great work, buried in a chat thread.

items.value: Great work, buried in a chat thread.
Nayna Surti of Naarie with her makeup kit, beside the quote: The talent was never the problem.
Nayna has been doing bridal makeup in Ahmedabad since 2001, with a 4.8 rating across 55 Google reviews. Brides who reached her were happy. Reaching her was the hard part.

The work lived on Instagram, so every inquiry started from zero. What do you charge, are you free on my date, can I see a full bridal look, do you bring your own products, do you travel to the venue. Each bride became a long DM thread before anything was confirmed.
In the wedding market a bride is comparing four or five artists in the same week. The one who answers her questions before she has to ask gets the trial.

title: The chat now starts at is my date free.

items.value: The chat now starts at is my date free.
Brides now find the site, see the portfolio and the price, and book directly on WhatsApp with no step in between.
The inquiries that arrive have already accepted the pricing and already seen the work. The conversation starts at is my date free, instead of what do you charge.
Because the feed, the ads and the site are run by the same team, a bride sees the same work and the same prices wherever she finds Naarie. Nothing contradicts anything.
Do you build websites for makeup artists and salons in Ahmedabad?
Yes. Naarie is a bridal makeup studio in Ahmedabad. The same structure works for salons, mehndi artists, photographers and any wedding service that gets booked over chat.
Should I put my prices on the website?
In the wedding market it usually helps. A starting price filters out the brides who were never going to book and makes the rest arrive ready to talk about dates.
Can brides book over WhatsApp instead of a form?
Yes, and most prefer it. We use WhatsApp links with the first message pre filled, so the inquiry lands in your chat with the context already there.
